top_signals.title: AI Trade Rebound Drives Limit Up Moves in Nvidia Supplier Stocks
top_signals.summary: Asian semiconductor-related stocks climbed after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang, resuscitating investor appetite for the artificial intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
